# FlareZone

`Flare.Components.FlareZone`

A coloured band drawn across part of a slider's or progress bar's track, marking a region of the host's own scale - "danger starts at 90". The range is absolute, so each zone reads as a pair of boundaries and is independent of the others. It registers with the host and renders nothing itself.

## Remarks

For a part-to-whole breakdown, where the parts define the scale instead of sitting on one, use FlareMeterSegment.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `End` | `double?` | `` | Parameter |  | End of the range on the host's scale. |
| `Start` | `double?` | `` | Parameter |  | Start of the range on the host's scale. The Start/End pair is ordered, so Start may exceed End. A missing bound collapses the zone, which is then dropped. |
| `Color` | `FlareColor` | `` | Parameter |  | Fill color. Role (e.g. Success) -> shared class; custom (FlareColor.Custom("#...")) -> inline token. Defaults to Primary. Inherited from `FlareZoneBase`. |
| `Label` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | What this region means. Shown wherever the host surfaces regions to the reader - a meter's legend and tooltip, a gauge's accessible value text - and never invented: a region with no label is described by its numbers alone. Inherited from `FlareZoneBase`. |
